data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure and order (GitHub profile, top repo, blog post, mail To/Subject/Body, discard) with the right email text, but it omits the {blog} parameter and the new-tab step, adds an unneeded Users filter, and lists Send instead of Discard, so a blog lookup or the final action couldn't be automated reliably.
